description: Temurin reproducible build comparison stage. SCM_REF must be specified — it identifies the exact published Adoptium binary to compare against. BUILD_REF pins the temurin-build branch used for the comparison tooling.

parameterGroups.name: Source Control
parameterGroups.description: Refs that control what is checked out and compared. SCM_REF is mandatory for this stage.

parameters.name: SCM_REF
parameters.description: Git tag/ref identifying the build to compare (e.g. jdk-21.0.2+13). Must not be empty — this stage cannot run without a specific version to compare against.

parameters.name: BUILD_REF
parameters.description: Git branch or tag for the temurin-build repository (comparison tooling). Empty = default defined in adoptium_pipeline_config.json.
